rules.condition: a rule or ADR is published
rules.obligation: it has testable gates or is removed
a JSON manifest is produced alongside the artifact
unused fields are present as na
each action is gated and validated against the plan
every applicable ADR is bound to an action (reverse audit)
the emit is audited immediately; gates of bound ADRs run default-closed

consequences: X1-X3 promoted by ADR 0026. Prose->gated-emit path by ADR 0027 (tools/nlc-emit-from-prose.py). X4 hub BBA interiors and semantic X6 remain expansion.
